question: During which of the following Prime Ministers' leadership were Fundamental Duties incorporated in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The concept of **Fundamental Duties** was incorporated into the **Indian Constitution** during the leadership of **Indira Gandhi**.
 
• These duties were introduced by the **42nd Amendment Act**, 1976, which is also known as the **Mini-Constitution** due to the extensive changes it made.
 
• Fundamental Duties were inspired by the Constitution of the **Soviet Union**, emphasizing the responsibilities of citizens toward their nation.
 
• Initially, there were **10 Fundamental Duties**, listed under **Article 51A** in Part IVA of the Constitution.
 
• These duties were introduced to promote a sense of **patriotism** and strengthen the unity and integrity of the country.
 
• The inclusion was a response to the **political and social unrest** during the Emergency period declared by Indira Gandhi's government (1975-1977).
 
• The Fundamental Duties are not legally enforceable but serve as a moral obligation for Indian citizens.
 
• Later, the **86th Amendment Act, 2002** added the **11th Fundamental Duty**, which emphasizes the importance of education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jawahar Lal Nehru**__

 __
 
• **Jawahar Lal Nehru** was the first Prime Minister of India and played a crucial role in shaping the **democratic framework** of the nation.
 
• He focused on building a modern India with strong institutions and introduced policies for **economic and social development**.
 
• However, the concept of **Fundamental Duties** was not incorporated during his tenure.
 
 
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**__
 __
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee** served as the Prime Minister of India and was known for his efforts toward **economic reforms** and strengthening India's **foreign policy**.
 
• While his tenure marked significant achievements, the **Fundamental Duties** were already part of the Constitution before he assumed office.
 
 
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri**__
 
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri** was known for his simplicity and his famous slogan "**Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan**" to encourage farmers and soldiers.
 
• He did not oversee any amendments related to the **Fundamental Duties** during his leadership.
